wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 10-001 wires the monster spawn filtering (per-skill bits MTF_EASY/NORMAL/HARD), the netgame guard (MTF_NETGAME drops the thing in single-player), the ambush flag transfer (MTF_AMBUSH propagates to the runtime MF_AMBUSH=0x8000 bit), and the P_SpawnMobj initial-state defaults into a single pure function. The new wrapper at src/vanilla/monsterSpawnFlags.ts imports the read-only flag constants and initMonsterSpawnState from src/ai/implement-monster-spawn-flags.ts and exposes evaluateMonsterSpawn(options, skill, isNetGame) returning a frozen MonsterSpawnVerdict.
publicSurface: evaluateMonsterSpawn(mapThingOptions: number, skill: VanillaSkillLevel, isNetGame: boolean): MonsterSpawnVerdict
